scenes.text: A meaningful line graph needs a title, labelled axes, sensible equal intervals and correctly plotted points.
What graph component is described as: the label along the horizontal axis? The answer is x-axis label. This feature is called the x-axis label.
A rainfall line graph for a school fundraiser is missing: the measure on the vertical axis. Which feature should be added? Pause to choose and explain.
A rainfall line graph for a school fundraiser is missing: the measure on the vertical axis. Which feature should be added? The answer is y-axis label. This feature is called the y-axis label.
